title: Auxiliary Equipment Manager
raw_text:
Job Title                                                                                                                   Job Code
Auxiliary Equipment Manager                                                                                                 001532
Job Family                                NOC                Short Title (30 Characters)                    Short Title (14 Characters)
Production                                TBD                AUXILIARY EQUIPMENT MANAGER                    AUX EQUIP MGR
Pay Plan              Career Field        Other Relationships and Rules
Enlisted              MMA                 NEC QXXX and 7XXX series and other NECs as assigned
Job Description
Auxiliary Equipment Managers are responsible for the management of auxiliary division operations, administration of Quality Assurance (QA),
calibration, Maintenance and Material Management (3-M) programs and for the management of maintenance and repair of hydraulic power plants,
hydraulic system components, emergency diesel engines, compressed gas systems (e.g., air, oxygen, hydrogen, and nitrogen), sanitation systems,
seawater systems, freshwater systems, oxygen generation equipment, atmosphere control equipment and submarine salvage equipment (e.g., watertight
hatches and doors); conduct critical work functions associated with movement of Naval tactical forces, repair, and equipment maintenance, enhanced
survivability, and rescue and recovery; provide security for operational forces and means; conduct Naval Special Warfare (NSW); provide personnel and
support; and train auxiliary technician and operator personnel.

nlx_method: NLx employer-demand profiles; private-only ownership unverified. Six-digit profiles pool specialty weighted task incidences after the existing review exclusion mask and five-job task-support floor; destination SOCs require 200 postings and nonzero tasks. Military profiles use binary accepted task presence and the same NLx reference RCA weights as civilian profiles: reciprocal positive task shares (zero weight for reference-absent tasks) of pooled retained support-five NLx weighted incidences across 1,016 reference specialties (912 eligible comparison candidates), sqrt(q * rca_weight), then L2 normalization and cosine. No military crosswalk codes enter the task ranking. All positive top-20 results retained; zero-similarity destinations are not recommendations. Shared field/rating duties are included; general Naval Standards remain separate by paygrade. Summary compares non-future individual source entries (versions can repeat) with nonempty reference sets; grouped, future and general-standard entries remain in all outputs. Hit@k is the fraction with at least one reference SOC recovered; ties are averaged exactly. References outside NLx remain in denominators.
